Fixed — the config now loads cleanly with no parse error, and TShock is running normally.

**What was wrong:** Your `config/config.json` had a trailing comma after the last entry (`"ApplicationRestTokens": {},`). That single comma made the whole file fail to parse (`parse error: Expected another key-value pair at line 157, column 3`), so TShock was silently throwing your entire config away and running on defaults every restart — that's why your spawn protection change wasn't taking.

**One heads-up:** while fixing the syntax, I noticed the file currently has:

- `"SpawnProtection": false`
- `"SpawnProtectionRadius": 25`

So the spawn protection bump you intended never actually got saved into this file — either the edit was lost or made elsewhere. If you tell me what you wanted (e.g. protection **on** with a specific radius), I'll set those values and restart again. Otherwise, you're good to make your edit now — it will stick this time.
